provenance.bound_rationale: BiGG records the universal reaction as reversible. This request specifies the irreversible forward direction, matching the engineered use of the enzyme as a one-way route to acetyl-phosphate.
provenance.subsystem_note: Conceptually a heterologous pathway. Not requested as a field: this model's SBML carries no subsystem annotations, so the writer would discard it and the check would report it as unverifiable rather than delivered.
